Class ItemDisplay

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ItemDisplay
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class ItemDisplay extends AbstractPanelElement
An item drawn at a fixed size, with its count and durability bar, and optionally a coloured outline. No input, no storage: it only draws. 
ItemDisplay.builder().item(() -> player.getMainHandItem()).size(16, 16)
        .outline(() -> locked ? 0xFFFF5555 : 0)
        .build();

Count and durability overlays show by default, as vanilla draws a slot; hideCount() and hideDurability() turn them off. A size other than 16 scales the item through the pose matrix (items are square: the smaller side is used).

Outline

outline(argb) draws a one-pixel line of that colour around the item's own silhouette, read every frame (0 for none). It is SlotRendering.drawItemOutline(GuiGraphicsExtractor, ItemStack, int, int, int), the same primitive a slot decoration uses.
